entities.description: A vertically elongated, irregularly shaped island with a light beige landmass and a thin black outline, set against a light blue background representing water. The island has a narrow northern tip that extends upward and slightly to the left, a broader central section, and a southern portion that tapers toward the bottom. Several smaller, circular islands or islets are scattered around the main landmass, particularly to the left and bottom.

A map of the island of Sri Lanka, depicted in a light beige color with a black outline, set against a light blue background representing the surrounding ocean. The island has a distinctive teardrop shape, with a small island visible to the east.
